_invalid_because: voting.threshold MUST be greater than 0 (RFC-MACP-0012 §4.1). A threshold of 0 is satisfied by an all-REJECT round under both 'majority' and 'weighted', so a policy that looks restrictive approves everything (issue #98, item 2). 'weighted' is used here rather than 'supermajority' so the rejection comes from threshold's own exclusiveMinimum and not from the supermajority allOf arm.
